title: Stuck in a lift with your friends for 30 days
idea: Survive it EP2 (extreme chain with Spud): one punch jams the lift at 799, every friend's fix makes the next one necessary, and the car ends in space
format: series: Survive it (title spoken at 0.0, day HUD, one cause-and-effect chain, stands alone)

hook.what: cold open (opener B): the burning lift in free fall with all five floating, then the cut back to day 1

visible.why: frame 0: the burning lift in free fall, all five floating and screaming (day 30 first)
day 1: five friends riding up, the Samurai's fist over the door-close button, the sign climbing
the mistake: the fist through the button, Spud's shock beside it
the jam: all five thrown up, a strand gone; the glares land on the Samurai
cause: the Wizard presses every button; the wall is the progress bar; the plate goes white-hot
effect: the wall explodes and burns; the lights are gone; the Wizard reads page two too late
cause: the only phone, and he haggles calmly while the wall burns behind him
Spud's panic close-up: he begs him to take the offer
effect: his counter-offer costs the last percent
cause: every hop snaps strands, and the last hop takes the last one
effect: the car falls the whole tower, all five floating, the sign racing down
cause: the giant spring at the bottom, squashed flat under the car, then it fires
effect: floor 800 slides past the open doorway, Spud reaches for it, nothing can stop the car
the payoff: the car over the Earth, the Samurai's record, Spud's leaf drooping
